event.description: Remove affine parameters from final LayerNorm after block pruning
event.proposal: family: normalization; retained incumbent is 3456 parameters at 99.9200%, a +0.92 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted results: attempt-0027 ln2 affine-free at 3520/99.79% and attempt-0028 ln1+ln2 affine-free at 3456/99.92%; same-family failed result: attempt-0007 final-only affine removal under standard attention at 5024/2.60%; prior attempts in this family: 4. Hypothesis: the final affine terms may only have been necessary when internal LayerNorms carried learned affine transformations; with both block pre-norms now affine-free, remove the last final scale/bias for 3424 parameters. This is more informative than repeating the old final-only test because the normalization context has changed through two accepted reductions. Keep mixed-digit training and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 3456 parameters.
